cli_checks.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os
def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for block in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
manifest = json.load(open("manifest.json", encoding="utf-8"))
for entry in manifest["entries"]:
    path = entry["path"]
    if not os.path.isfile(path) or sha(path) != entry["sha256"]:
        raise SystemExit("READ_FAIL manifest member " + path)
ready = json.load(open("READY.json", encoding="utf-8"))
if ready.get("status") != "READY":
    raise SystemExit("READ_FAIL READY " + str(ready.get("status")))
print("READ_STAGE=CONTRACT_OK entries=%d ready=READY" % len(manifest["entries"]))
PY
printf '\n===== implementation-contract.json =====\n'
cat implementation-contract.json
printf '\n===== project-context.json =====\n'
cat project-context.json
PIN=$(python3 -B -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("project-context.json", encoding="utf-8"))["read_first"][0]["path"])')
printf '\n===== INPUTS-PIN.json =====\n'
cat "$PIN"
for f in requirements.md acceptance.md design.md DESIGN.md tasks.md verification-intent.json; do
  printf '\n===== %s =====\n' "$f"
  cat "$f"
done
echo "READ_STAGE=COMPLETE"

cli_checks.command:

trap 'rc=$?; printf "EXEC_FAIL stage=%s rc=%s\n" "$STAGE" "$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"' ERR
PIN=/var/tmp/SYSTEM-E2E-003/INPUTS-PIN.json
STAGE=worktree
WT=$(python3 -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))["worktree"])' "$PIN")
[ -n "$WT" ]
[ -d "$WT" ]
cd "$WT"
STAGE=target
[ ! -e e2e ]
[ ! -L e2e ]
[ ! -e RESULT.json ]
[ ! -L RESULT.json ]
STAGE=inputs
( cd "$HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE/inputs" && sha256sum --strict -c INPUTS.sha256 >/dev/null )
echo "INPUTS_OK"
STAGE=copy
mkdir -p e2e
cp -a "$HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE/inputs/fixture" e2e/valid_package
C="$HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE/inputs/compiler"

python3 -B "$C/hash_manifest.py" e2e/valid_package
STAGE=build_contract
python3 -B "$C/build_contract.py" e2e/valid_package

python3 -B "$C/validate_package.py" e2e/valid_package --project-root e2e/valid_package/project
STAGE=result
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
pkg = Path("e2e/valid_package")
manifest = json.loads((pkg / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
contract = json.loads((pkg / "implementation-contract.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
report = json.loads((pkg / "validation-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ready = json.loads((pkg / "READY.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
result = {
    "task_id": "SYSTEM-E2E-003",
    "fixture_id": contract["contract_id"],
    "manifest_entries": len(manifest["entries"]),
    "requirements": len(contract["requirements"]),
    "tasks": len(contract["tasks"]),
    "validator_status": report["status"],
    "errors": len(report["errors"]),
}
assert ready["status"] == report["status"] == "READY"
assert result["errors"] == 0
Path("RESULT.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("RESULT_WRITTEN " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
PY

python3 -B - <<'PY'
